title: Meetnetten.be transect counts of Aeshna isoceles (Green-eyed Hawker), Flanders, Belgium, 2017-2025
creator: Piesschaert, Frederik; De Knijf, Geert; Brosens, Dimitri; Westra, Toon; Desmet, Peter; Ledegen, Hannes; Pollet, Marc (Research Institute for Nature and Forest, INBO)
citation: Piesschaert F, De Knijf G, Brosens D, Westra T, Desmet P, Ledegen H, Pollet M (2026). Meetnetten.be - Transects for dragonflies in Flanders, Belgium. Version 1.28. Research Institute for Nature and Forest (INBO). Sampling event dataset. https://doi.org/10.15468/y8u6e9
abstract: Repeated transect counts of adult Aeshna isoceles at 30 monitored populations in Flanders, from the Meetnetten.be priority-species monitoring network run by INBO and Natuurpunt Studie with specialised volunteers. Each population is counted in some years (10 of 30 per year), at least twice in a counting year while adults fly.
samplingProtocol: Transect count of adults along a 100-500 m shore transect in good dragonfly weather, 11:00-16:30, within 2 m of the bank and 3-5 m above the water (De Knijf et al. 2019); at least two counts in a counting year.
closure: occasion within period (counts within one flight season); populations may change between years
geographicCoverage: Flanders, Belgium (coordinates generalised by INBO to 1 km or 10 km UTM square centroids)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: Generalised by the publisher (INBO) to the centroid of a 1 km (uncertainty 707 m) or 10 km (7071 m) UTM square before publication; kept as published.

notes: y sums all adult and teneral categories the app records (male, female, unknown, teneral, copula, egg-laying); copula is summed as recorded. 2 count(s) are dated outside May-August as published (e.g. 2025-12-11), probably data-entry errors in the date; kept. obs_transect_length_m is NA where INBO gives 'unknown'.

notShipped.exuviae: the exuviae category (a different life stage, counted under a separate Meetnetten protocol)
notShipped.category breakdown: sex / teneral / copula / egg-laying counts are summed into y
notShipped.other species: dragonflies other than the project's target are recorded at some counts only (incidental); not a complete community record
notShipped.other projects: the other two target species are separate tables (inbo_2026_flanders_calvir_count, inbo_2026_flanders_coepul_count)
